high_level_description: The image depicts a group of people standing in front of a confectionery shop named "Ghantewala Confectioners." The shop's signboard is prominently displayed at the top, indicating that it was established in 1790 and is celebrating 200 years of business. The signboard is blue with white text and features decorative floral garlands hanging below it. The shop's menu is displayed on a banner attached to the signboard. It lists several items along with their prices: काजू बर्फी (Cashew Barfi) for Rs. 900
